description_en: Retrieves information about an application deployed in a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster or a Serverless Kubernetes (ASK) cluster
description_zh: 获取容器服务K8s集群或Serverless K8s集群中部署的应用信息
name: GetK8sApplication

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html operation to obtain the application ID
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，可通过调用ListApplication接口获取，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The source of the query.

If this parameter is empty, a regular query is performed.

deploy: The query is initiated from the deployment page
parameters.help_zh:
查询来源：
为空表示普通查询。
deploy表示从部署页面进入查询
parameters.name: from
